s.note: Garlic butter bread under melted mozzarella.
s.how: Mash the butter with the garlic and parsley. Spread it between the slices and over the top, then scatter with mozzarella. Bake at 200C until golden and bubbling.
shop: 1 Italian loaf, sliced not quite through@Bakery

s.note: Salami, provolone, olives and marinated peppers.
s.how: Fold the salami and lay it on a large platter. Add the provolone, olives, peppers and artichokes in piles. Tuck in the grissini and drizzle with oil.

m.n: Spaghetti and meatballs out by the airport
m.note: The spaghetti place out by the airport. Beef and pork meatballs in red sauce over spaghetti.
m.how: Mix the minces, breadcrumbs, egg, parmesan and a third of the garlic and roll into 20 balls. Brown the meatballs in batches, then soften the onion and the rest of the garlic in the same pan. Add the passata, return the meatballs and simmer gently until cooked through. Cook the spaghetti, toss with some of the sauce and top with meatballs, basil and parmesan.
shop: 40g parmesan, grated, plus extra to serve@Dairy

m.note: Thin-crust pepperoni pizza with mozzarella and dried oregano.
m.how: Heat the oven as hot as it goes with a tray inside. Stretch the dough thin and spread with sauce. Top with mozzarella, pepperoni and oregano. Bake on the hot tray until blistered and crisp. Drizzle with oil and cut into squares.

w.note: Crisp cannoli shells filled with ricotta and chocolate chips.
w.how: Beat the ricotta with the icing sugar, vanilla and orange zest until smooth. Fold in the chocolate chips and spoon into a piping bag. Pipe into the shells, dip the ends in pistachios and dust with icing sugar.
shop: 80g icing sugar, plus extra to dust@Pantry

d.note: Chianti red wine, a carafe poured short. Mr White calls them the one-hit Wonders.
d.how: Open the Chianti and pour it into a carafe to breathe. Serve in short tumblers at the table.

shopping: 1 Italian loaf, sliced not quite through@Bakery
40g parmesan, grated, plus extra to serve@Dairy
80g icing sugar, plus extra to dust@Pantry
